_readme: Branch agent-locks, never merged. Read: git fetch origin agent-locks && git show origin/agent-locks:.agent-lock.json. Lock: add an entry and push (a rejected non-fast-forward push means re-read and retry). Unlock: remove the entry when the PR merges. An entry past expires_at is abandoned and may be removed by the other agent. Owner-approved 07-10-2026 (Claude · № 11,660 07-Oct).
